steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Waaaaahhhh! Ugh, hold on. I should do a different cry next time, I'm getting rather tired of this one...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, is he alright?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: No need to worry, he'll be back in a minute.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Okay... is he like... a person? I've never heard of anyone like him before.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: No idea, the High Priest only told me he's lived here for a very long time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright then. What else can we say...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Phew, he's really something...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Gavial, your head is bleeding. Are you okay?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's fine, just a scratch. Tomimi, bring me my medical bag here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Where did Tomimi go?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Here's your bag. And Tomimi, I think I saw her running off somewhere right before we won the fight.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Thanks. She didn't get scared, did she? Anyway, let's patch ourselves up first.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You go check if anyone's injured, and bring them to me if they are. I'll take care of them.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Leave it to me!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Haha, no problem.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Ugh, what a pain. Fine.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Quit yer belly-achin'.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor... hmm?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The Big Ugly...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sorry, Zumama. We had to take it apart.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I checked your engine, I think it's working fine. You can have it back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh yeah? That's great!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You really won't stay, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, just like you, I've found my calling.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: To be a doctor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's it.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Is doctoring fun?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Is building machines fun?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It is.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Same here.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But you still have to be the Great Chief.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Any way you slice it, you beat the Big, Ugly Thing. You won, Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Look, everyone's here again. They're looking to you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch. Doctor, what do we do?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're not giving me anything here!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, I know you're awake! I'm a doctor!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch. Doctor, I really want to punch you right now.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, are you hurt?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? I'm fine. Where did you run off to?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Oh, that... I had to go pee!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Okay... Hm?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What's wrong, Gavial? Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm... Haha, I've got it!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Everyone, listen up!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I beat the Big Ugly, so I'm going to be the Great Chief.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And so, my message to you is——

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Your fists are everything!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh? Gavial, are you staying here to be the Great Chief?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I have something very important I must do, so I have to leave.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Worry not, though! When I'm gone, Tomimi will give orders on my behalf!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Just treat Tomimi as you would treat me!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh, w-w-what?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Is that really gonna fly? Don't these people worship strength over everything?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial is the Great Chief after all. She defeated everyone, so her word is law.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha. Zumama, machines are pretty cool, but I think I'll stick with my fists after all.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hmph. Don't forget, I still don't recognize you. I'll build an even greater machine and challenge you again.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sure, I'll be waiting.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, right. Before that, you need to come with me for a bit.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You need to come with me to Rhodes Island to get an Oripathy checkup.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Can I refuse? I still have to work on the Big Ugly...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You don't have a choice this time. Besides, until Tomimi takes over, I'm still the Great Chief. I'll bring you back even if I have to kidnap you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Gavial, are you going to leave after all?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yep, I'll probably be leaving right as soon as we get the engine back in the aircraft.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I-I won't let you leave!
